data.one_liner: Flutter camera plugin for Linux, macOS, and Windows desktop platforms.
data.what_it_does: Implements camera_platform_interface to provide desktop support for the standard camera package. Enables camera enumeration, live preview, photo capture, video recording, and image streaming on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
use_when: You need camera preview, photo capture, or video recording in a Flutter desktop app.
You want to use the standard camera package API across mobile and desktop platforms.
avoid_when: You require mobile platforms (use the standard camera package instead).
You need advanced mobile features like flash/torch control, exposure/focus point selection, or zoom beyond 1.0x.
strengths: Seamless integration with the standard camera package and CameraController API.
Supports Linux, macOS, and Windows with native backends (GStreamer, AVFoundation, Media Foundation).
Provides image streaming and custom FPS/bitrate controls.
weaknesses: Desktop cameras generally lack mobile features like flash, touch-to-focus, and zoom.
Requires platform-specific library setup on Linux (GStreamer) and permission descriptions on macOS.
data.setup_notes: Linux requires installing GStreamer development libraries. macOS requires adding camera and microphone usage descriptions to Info.plist and optionally entitlements for sandboxed apps.
